mapper.sql: f.id, f.student_id, f.batch_id, f.level, f.source, f.source_id, f.summary, f.measures, f.counselor_id, f.status, f.opened_at, f.closed_at, f.created_by, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(u.student_id, '') AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, '') AS class_name, COALESCE(sp.major, '') AS major, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.nickname, c.username) AS counselor_name
FROM psyche_focus f LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = f.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = f.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = f.counselor_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_focus (student_id, batch_id, level, source, source_id, summary, measures, counselor_id, status, opened_at, closed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{batchId}, #{level}, #{source}, #{sourceId}, #{summary}, #{measures}, #{counselorId}, #{status}, #{openedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE f.student_id = #{studentId} AND f.deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE psyche_focus SET level = #{focus.level}, summary = #{focus.summary}, measures = #{focus.measures}, counselor_id = #{focus.counselorId}, status = #{focus.status}, closed_at = #{focus.closedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{focus.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE psyche_focus SET status = 'following', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'open'
mapper.select:
SELECT f.level AS level, COUNT(*) AS cnt
WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.batch_id = #{batchId} AND (sp.counselor_id = #{scope} OR f.counselor_id = #{scope}) GROUP BY f.level
